verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs list integrations with Azure OpenAI and Ollama, which covers the bring-your-own-backend half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows LobeChat itself displaying token usage or cost per model or per conversation. The Langfuse tracing integration is a separate external observability tool and earns no credit for in-product usage or cost visibility. Missing for 10: in-product token usage tracking, per-model and per-conversation cost display, explicit documentation of entering your own API keys or subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
